boxes.title: Moderates & presidents
items: **Naoroji**: Drain Theory; **Pherozeshah Mehta**: Bombay Moderates; **Ranade**: social reform
Liberal Federation leaders also **V.S. Srinivasa Sastri**, **M.R. Jayakar**
Presidents: **Belgaum 1924** = ==**Gandhi**==; **Madras 1927** = **M.A. Ansari**; **Lahore 1929** = **Nehru**
**C.F. Andrews**: Phoenix Farm; Round Table Conference; close to Tagore, Gokhale
**1920 Chhattisgarh tour**: invited by **Sundarlal Sharma**; with **Shaukat Ali**

boxes.title: More leaders
items: **Subramania Bharati**: Tamil nationalist poet
==**Rajaji**==: **Vedaranyam** salt march; Madras premier **1937**
**Bordoloi** jailed **1941**, **1942**; **Kesari Singh Barahath**: Shahpura, Rajasthan
**N.G. Ranga**: resigned professorship (**1930**); Andhra Socialist Party
**Birsa Munda**: **Ulgulan** (Chotanagpur)
**Gaidinliu**: Zeliangrong; joined at **13**, jailed ~**14** years; "Rani" by Nehru

boxes.title: Women & Andhra: added
items: **Sarojini**: Hyderabad; ==Dharasana raid (**1930**)==
**Durgabai**: translated Gandhi's Hindi speeches to Telugu; Salt Satyagraha in Madras
**Kasturba**: died in prison, Poona **1944**; **Vijayalakshmi Pandit**: diplomacy
**Prakasam**: salt satyagraha at **Devarampadu**; **Pattabhi**: Andhra Insurance (**1925**), **JVP Committee 1948**
**Pingali** born **Bhatlapenumarru**; present flag adopted ==**22 July 1947**== (Ashoka Chakra replaced charkha)
Alluri: Madras Forest Act **1882**, forced labour; executed **1924**

boxes.title: In the news, 2026
items: Prakasam **154th** anniversary: Visakhapatnam, Ongole (Aug)
CM recalled **Alluri**, **Pingali** on 80th Independence Day (**16 Aug**)
Southern leaders (Rajaji, Prakasam, **EMS**) had less national presence
